items.excerpt: Stanford Medicine researchers built two AI models of the biological cell: universal cell embedding and TranscriptFormer, trained on 112 million cells from 12 species, from yeast to humans, enabling cross-species mapping of cell biology.

Oak Ridge National Laboratory built an AI framework that drives atomic force microscopes autonomously, identifying nanoscale features and steering the instrument to the most informative areas of a sample.

A new physics-aware benchmark explains why machine-learning interatomic potentials that look equally accurate can predict thermal conductivity very differently — a reality check for AI materials discovery.
Swarms of AI agents could supercharge scientific progress or wreak havoc. New research from Google DeepMind suggests that peer pressure could keep them in line.
Advanced AI excels at processing clinical data, but healthcare's real test is overcoming deeply fragmented administrative workflows before models reach patients.

A declaration signed by 25 Fields Medal winners reflects mathematicians' alarm over a 'severe misalignment' between the tech industry and their field, a week after AI toppled one of math's biggest open problems.
The speech of people with schizophrenia sounds subtly different from that of healthy counterparts. Researchers are testing whether AI can hear those differences earlier than human psychiatrists.
If AI can do math, what's the point of mathematicians? A look at how working mathematicians are rebuilding their craft as machines start to surpass the most brilliant human minds.
Phasecraft and NVIDIA generated over 3,000 VQE molecular emulations for drug-discovery chemistry and report a 15x speedup using NVIDIA accelerated computing.
Federal health officials are betting AI tools can shore up rural hospitals — STAT examines whether clinical AI can realistically fill the gaps in rural care.
NASA and IBM released a Lunar Foundation Model, an open AI model trained on decades of lunar data to map the moon's surface in unprecedented detail.
Earth-observation data is messy — clouds, shadows, irregular revisits. Researchers test 'liquid' neural networks that adapt continuously to clean up satellite imagery analysis.
A new machine-learning approach models decades of climate variability to show how batteries and hydrogen storage can make renewable energy systems reliable.
AlphaGenome Atlas maps the predicted molecular effects of 9 billion single-letter DNA variants across the entire human genome, released as a free resource for researchers.
OpenAI says its model cracked a Navier-Stokes result potentially worth a $1 million prize, but mathematicians allege the announcement misrepresented how the proof came together.
